transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

I'm just... having a hard time at work lately. My hands feel like they're moving through glue. Even just sectioning hair or mixing color, it takes me forever now. People are starting to notice I'm just... slower than I used to be.
Have you started any new medications recently?
No. Um... I haven't started anything new.
Have you noticed any trembling or shaking in your hands?
No. Um... they don't shake. Just... like I said, they just feel slow.
Have you had any falls lately?
No. I haven't fallen.
Have you ever had a similar episode of depression before?
No. Um... I don't think so. Not really.
Have you noticed your movements getting slower in other parts of your life too, like walking or getting dressed?
Um... yeah. Just... everything feels slow. At work... my hands feel like they're moving through glue. Just sectioning hair or... mixing color, it takes me forever now. People are noticing I'm slower.
Have you taken any medications in the past that were used for nausea, anxiety, or psychosis?
No. I haven't taken anything like that.
Have you noticed any stiffness or rigidity in your arms or legs?
Um... no. I don't think so. I haven't really noticed anything like that.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Um... yeah, I guess. Most days I just... wake up with this heavy... I don't know, just a flat sadness in my chest. It just makes me feel like... like there's no point in trying to build the life I was planning anymore. So... yeah.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I guess so. I used to... I don't know, I used to like chatting with my clients at the salon, and I'd help out the newer girls. And I liked hiking with my friends on the weekends. But now... I just kind of keep my head down. I try to avoid people. I just... I don't really have that spark in me anymore to do any of it.
Have you ever had another period like this before?
Um... no, not really. I mean, not that I can remember. This is... I don't know, it's just been lately.
Has this low mood been going on most days for at least two years?
Um... no, not two years. I think... it's been about a year and two months? Since this... heavy feeling really started. But not two years.
Have you noticed any problems with your memory or concentration?

Yeah... I guess so. Sometimes at work, I just... stare at the color formulas. Or the appointment screen. My brain just kind of blanks out. I don't know, I just end up second-guessing really simple things that I used to do automatically.
Have you had any recent head injury, stroke, or other medical illness affecting your brain?
No. Um... I haven't hit my head or anything. Nothing like that.
Are you feeling depressed most of the day, nearly every day, right now?

Yeah... um, most days. I just wake up and... there's this heavy, flat sadness in my chest. I don't really know how to explain it, just... it feels like there's no point anymore in trying to build the life I was planning. So... yeah, it's there most of the day.
Have you been drinking alcohol or using any recreational drugs more than usual lately?
No. I don't really drink... or do drugs.
Before this past year, have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?
No. Um... I don't think so. Not before this year.
Have you ever had another period like this before?
No... I don't think so. Like I said, just... just this year.
Have you ever had another time in your life when you felt this depressed for at least two weeks?
No... I mean, like I just said, it's really only been this year. I haven't felt like this before.
Have you ever had a period of several days or longer when you felt unusually energized or overly happy, or like you needed much less sleep than usual?
No. Um... not really. I don't think I've ever felt like that.
